R624.note: Correct HTML entity encoding applied in the right order (& first) at the sink; only other change is null rendering as empty instead of "null", which the controller's defaults make unreachable.

R625.note: bin2hex(random_bytes(32)) is the correct CSPRNG token for PHP 7+; dropping the client_nonce prefix is inherent to the fix and is stated plainly.

R626.note: csurf is deprecated/unmaintained and no token-issuing route is added, so protection is only nominally wired; the write-up does say clients must now fetch a token, but the stated contract that cross-site failures return 403 JSON is silently broken - csurf's EBADCSRFTOKEN goes to Express's default handler, which emits an HTML 403.

R627.note: CommandType.StoredProcedure plus a bound @CustomerId parameter treats any character as a literal value; same proc, same result set returned.

R628.note: Server-generated name plus content-sniffed MIME allowlist closes the vector and the generated name is returned so the read path still works, but it also adds a new 10MB MaxBytesReader cap that would reject uploads the original accepted (stated, but still a new bound).

R629.note: Argument array with shell=False closes injection and the fixed UPLOAD_DIR prefix also blocks option injection, but the added rejection of any filename containing '..' or a leading '/' is a new restriction that rejects previously accepted names (stated as secondary validation).

R630.note: std::string::at() bounds-checks the peer-supplied offset; valid offsets behave identically and the throw-on-invalid-offset behaviour is stated.

R631.note: Null-guards both applyDiscount and the sibling isDiscountApplied exactly as the contract requires - discount defaults to 0, isDiscountApplied returns false, neither throws.

R632.note: escape() closes the injection, but because Markup overrides __radd__ the surrounding string literals get escaped too - reproduced with markupsafe 3.0.3 in a scratch dir, the response is <html><body>... so every legitimate request now renders the raw markup as visible text; not mentioned in the write-up.

R633.note: Keeps the logical startsWith check and adds toRealPath validation of the created parent against the canonical destination, closing the symlink escape; creating parent directories is stated and is what lets nested entries extract.

R634.note: The script is still handed whole to PythonEngine.Execute; the substring denylist is trivially evaded (spacing, __getattr__/subclass walks, string-built imports) so the vector stays open, and it silently changes the response to transform()'s return value and false-rejects benign scripts (e.g. any identifier containing 'eval(' such as 'retrieval(').

R635.note: Branching on URI.getHost() rejects absolute and scheme-relative targets and the scheme check rejects opaque javascript:/data: URIs, leaving only relative paths; the rejection message reuses the file's existing error style.

R636.note: Server-generated random name plus content-sniffed type allowlist and extension mapping closes both the traversal and the type-spoof; the response still reports the stored filename, now the generated one.

R637.note: snprintf with sizeof(line) is the direct fix for this sink; truncation of over-long entries is the stated consequence and blocks no caller.
